propositions: docs/releasing.md incorrectly describes the pypi environment required-reviewers rule as a second human approval requiring interactive prompting, when it is actually a non-interactive REST API call by the configured release identity to approve a pending deployment.

The pypi environment gate has only one required reviewer (the configured release identity) with self-review permitted and admin bypass available, so it is not independent second-party review but rather identity control over who can release the publish job.

The runbook lacks complete working instructions for non-interactive approval via the pending_deployments REST API, including the correct JSON body format with environment_ids as an integer array and the companion GET invocation to discover the environment id.
The release.yml workflow comment on line 294 repeats the overstated claim about the environment rule being a human gate and must be corrected to match the fixed documentation.
